name: FLVC File Format
aliases: Free Lossless Voxel Compression (FLVC) File Format
definition: FLVC is a file format for voxel data, produced based on research results. It uses a container format with a specific magic byte sequence and supports zlib-compressed content for non-empty volumes.
summary: FLVC is a container format for sparse voxel octrees that uses zlib compression and includes a structured header for flexible attribute storage, distinguishing it from raw binary dumps.
